purpose: Apply an event or rule to each unit or recurring interval.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Noun / duration / verb dictionary form + ごとに
There are more passengers at each station.
We take a break every two hours.
Each time I see my younger brother, he has grown taller.
formation: Noun / duration / verb dictionary form + ごとに
restrictions: Emphasizes regular units; distinguish an interval from a total duration.
mistake: 三日ごとに means every three days, not three times per day.
